gazette_location.description_raw_en: No. 1420.—PUBLIC WORKS DEPARTMENT. It is hereby notified that the following roads within N.K.I.L. 3594, Yat Yat Chuen Development Company's Estate, north of Boundary Street, will be known in future as described hereunder:— (a) Description: Road commencing from the west boundary of the lot, running in an easterly direction bordering the southern boundary of the lot thence continuing in a north-easterly direction bordering the eastern boundary of the lot and terminating at its junction with Begonia Road as shown coloured pink on plan No. R.K. 398A signed by the Director of Public Works and dated 18th November, 1953. Proposed Name: TAT CHEE AVENUE. Chinese Version: 達之路.

No. 1420.—PUBLIC WORKS DEPARTMENT. It is hereby notified that the following roads within N.K.I.L. 3594, Yat Yat Chuen Development Company's Estate, north of Boundary Street, will be known in future as described hereunder:— (b) Description: Road commencing at its junction with Marigold Road, running in a northerly direction and terminating at the junction with Dianthus Road as shown coloured blue on plan No. R.K. 398A signed by the Director of Public Works and dated 18th November, 1953. Proposed Name: MAGNOLIA ROAD. Chinese Version: 玉蘭路.
